in_hebrew.name: פאלון
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם פאלון מקורו כנראה בשפה האירית והוא אינו מופיע ישירות בכתבי הקודש העבריים. עם זאת, ניתן לפרש את משמעותו כ'נפילת האל' או 'נופל אליו', הקושרת את הנושא אל מונחים עבריים כגון 'נפילה' או 'הפלה', שיכולים להתייחס אל הנחה או הדגשה של התערבות אלוהית.

in_greek.name: Φάλλων
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Φάλλων πιθανόν να έχει προέλευση από την Ιρλανδία και να μην απαντάται άμεσα στα κείμενα της Καινής Διαθήκης ή της Septuaginta. Η ετυμολογία του μπορεί να συνδεθεί με λέξεις που σημαίνουν πτώση ή το fallen, υπονοώντας μια πνευματική πτώση ή ανάδειξη μέσω θείου έργου.

in_latin.name: Fallon
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Fallon, origine fortasse ex Hibernia, in primis scripturis Christianis non invenitur. Etymologia autem suggerit quidem notionem casus vel cadendi, quae potest interpretari tamquam divina providentia seu fatum, sive casus qui fit per voluntatem Dei.

in_english.meaning: Descendant of fall or strong in faith
in_english.long_meaning: The name Fallon, likely of Irish origin, translates to 'descendant of fall' or 'strong in faith'. It does not have a direct reference in the Bible but relates to themes of spiritual descent or strength. Historically, it may signify a family lineage or a characteristic of faithfulness. In Christian tradition, it symbolizes resilience and devotion.

data.cultural_impact: Fallon is a traditional Irish name, implying a deep connection to the rich history and heritage of the Irish culture. This name resonates with the worn-out charm of the Emerald Isle and speaks to our sense of belonging to a long and proud lineage. Today, it is popular throughout the English-speaking world due to the widespread Irish diaspora.
data.spiritual_significance: In Celtic mythology and spirituality, rivers were revered as powerful entities, connecting the world above with the world below. Fallon, being a name that directly translates to 'little river', carries this deep spiritual significance. It serves as a constant reminder of the interconnectedness of all things and the importance of finding harmony within nature. Additionally, as a Christian name, it can be interpreted as a reflection of God's boundless love for His children – just as a river flows ceaselessly to provide life and nourishment, so too does God's love never cease to flow.
